# registry_advisories (Data Source)

Lists CVE security advisories from the registry. Use active_only = true to restrict to currently active advisories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_advisories" "active_critical" {
  active_only = true
  severities  = ["high", "critical"]
}

output "active_cves" {
  value = [for a in data.registry_advisories.active_critical.advisories : a.external_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active_only` (Boolean) If true, only returns currently active advisories. Defaults to false (returns all).
- `severities` (List of String) Optional list of severity values to filter by (e.g. ['high', 'critical']).

### Read-Only

- `advisories` (Attributes List) List of matching advisories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advisories))

<a id="nestedatt--advisories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advisories`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the advisory is currently active.
- `description` (String) Advisory description.
- `external_id` (String) CVE identifier (e.g. CVE-2024-12345).
- `id` (String) Internal UUID.
- `published_at` (String) ISO 8601 publish timestamp.
- `resolved_at` (String) ISO 8601 resolution timestamp (empty if unresolved).
- `severity` (String) Severity level.
- `title` (String) Advisory title.
- `url` (String) Reference URL.
